generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: Environment filtering alone does not isolate role credentials when filesystem, persistent credential-store, process-identity, or artifact surfaces remain shared.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Sanitize named environment variables while allowing multiple roles to execute under one operating-system identity with mutually readable secret storage.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Separate privileged model roles by operating-system identity and minimize secret lifetime and inherited environment.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Execute real cross-role readability probes across every material credential surface before handoff.
